claims.summary: Hypothesis: the system employs a dynamic or heuristic-driven evaluation for qualitative warnings rather than a static term set.
claims.disposition: Verified, stronger than hypothesized. interpretation_risk_terms (guards.rs:548-569, sha256:94ddbd3f...b4b2b11) flattens '_' and '-' to spaces, lowercases, then requires one of 10 context needles (introspect, motif, eigenvalue, lambda, trace, spectral, cascade, data, complexity, lambda-sign) before matching 5 labeled families: over-interpretation, single-motif, forced-narrative, rigid-structure, reductive-collapse. Gate plus alias families is the heuristic she inferred.

claims.disposition: Contradicted on three points. (1) The string is rendered OUTPUT at core.rs:8455 (interpretation_risk_line), not input.
